display.purpose: Hero numerals, net worth totals, and editorial header numbers.

body.purpose: Standard UI text and table content.

shadows.name: shadow-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive lift elevation on card hover.

shadows.name: shadow-modal
shadows.purpose: High elevation depth for modals and popovers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button in deep forest green
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #1a4d2e; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(26,77,46,0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #2d7d46; transform: translateY(-2px); shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(26,77,46,0.25); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary or subtle inline action button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background-color: transparent; color: #1a4d2e; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: rgba(232, 245, 236, 0.7); }

components.name: Premium Card
components.description: Flagship card container with green-tinted border and soft elevation
components.css: .ds-card-premium { background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(26, 77, 46, 0.1); box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(26, 77, 46, 0.08); padding: 24px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #5c6b5e; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1c2b20; }

components.name: Micro Tag Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background-color: rgba(232, 245, 236, 0.8); color: #1a4d2e; border: 1px solid rgba(26, 77, 46, 0.1); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: #5c6b5e; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: rgba(232, 245, 236, 0.5); color: #1a4d2e; } .ds-nav-item.active { background-color: #e8f5ec; color: #1a4d2e; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Finly Zen is designed as a serene, high-craft financial ledger. Inspired by editorial publishing and Japanese zen gardens, it pairs structured financial data with organic forest greens, pale mint surfaces, soft ambient elevation, and timeless serif typography. The environment eliminates visual anxiety, turning financial tracking and stock analysis into a calm, focused ritual.
keyCharacteristics: Light-mode only design architecture (no dark mode).
Dual typography model: Cormorant Garamond for editorial numerals and titles; Outfit for clean UI labels and body text.
Opacity modulation (forest/10, sage/50, spring/10) for depth and subtle interaction states.
Micro-typography signatures: uppercase tracking-widest labels (text-[10px] font-bold text-earth uppercase).
Green-tinted soft elevation (shadow-premium) and thin translucent borders (border-forest/10).

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Primary forest green is used deliberately on ≤15% of screen real estate. Its quiet authority depends on not saturating the user's field of view.

rules.name: The Green Border Rule
rules.body: Borders are never pure gray (#e5e7eb). All borders use translucent green tinting (border border-forest/10).

rules.name: The Editorial Numeral Rule
rules.body: Financial summary totals and net worth displays use Cormorant Garamond. Operational UI numbers use Outfit.

rules.name: The Layered Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat on #f0f7f2 mint background with thin border-forest/10 borders and shadow-premium depth.

dos: Do use Cormorant Garamond for major financial numerals, net worth headers, and editorial titles.
Do apply opacity modulation (forest/10, sage/50) for subtle borders, hover fills, and surface tints.
Do format section labels as uppercase micro-typography (text-[10px] font-bold text-earth uppercase tracking-widest).
Do wrap primary screen modules in .premium-card.
donts: Don't introduce dark mode styles, dark background utilities, or pure black backgrounds.
Don't use pure gray borders (border-gray-200 or #e5e7eb); always use translucent green tinting (border-forest/10).
Don't clutter screens with dense action buttons; keep primary actions limited and prioritized.
Don't break the dual font hierarchy by using sans-serif for hero numbers or serif for micro UI labels.
